text:
jules: Quick sync  planning a staged FF flip for `routing.cohort_surge` during low-traffic window (Thu 2026-07-08 01:00-02:00 UTC). Need ramp + pin/rollback agreement.
ravi: Proposed: canary 0.5% (5m) -> small 3% (10m) -> medium 15% (20m). Holdpoint at end of each stage.
sara: Gating: combined errors (5xx + model-timeout) > 0.6% OR p95 latency > 320ms => hold. Also a lightweight quality probe: sample 0.5% outputs, run quick-eval; quality delta > 3% => hold.
jules: If hold occurs at stage >0.5%, auto-pin cohort to previous stable and open incident channel. If pin fails, escalate to oncall immediately.
oncall-ops: I'll be covering the window. Set alerts to require 2 consecutive 3m buckets to avoid noise. I'll attach alert screenshots before EOD.

Runbook snippet (paste to ops):
```
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \ 
  --window "2026-07-08T01:00Z/2026-07-08T02:00Z" \ 
  --ff routing.cohort_surge --ramp "0.5:5m,3:10m,15:20m" \ 
  --hold "errors>0.6% OR p95>320ms OR quality_regress>3%" --hold-agg "2x3m" \ 
  --on-breach action=pin(previous) --fallback route=model-quant-v1 \ 
  --meta rollout_tag=cohort-surge-0708
```

ravi: Extra safety: if p95 spikes but errors are flat, prefer hold+cache-warm (see unblock checklist) before pin.
sara: Add telemetry tag `rollout=cohort-surge-0708` and log cohort_id on any pin action so postmortem can slice.
jules: Release notes blurb: "Night window rollout for routing.cohort_surge: staged ramp with SLO gates and auto-pin on breach. Oncall monitoring and variant fallback enabled." Keep public note short.

oncall-ops: Two small ops asks: 1) make sure alert aggregation is 2 consecutive buckets; 2) enable temporary trace sampling for the cohorts during the window. I'll post screenshots when complete.

deploy-bot: Scheduling job: 2026-07-08T01:00Z/2026-07-08T02:00Z. Auto-pin and fallback configured. Reminder: any stage paused >15m requires manual resume. Notifications will post to #eng-releases at T-20m and at start.

jules: All approvals?
ravi: Approved.
sara: Approved.
oncall-ops: Approved, I'll be oncall.
deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and published.
